title: When You Hear but Don’t Change — Ezekiel 33:31
paragraphs: When You Hear but Don’t Change — Ezekiel 33:31

They sat under the Word.
They nodded at the truth.
They even wept.
That is the terror of Ezekiel 33:31.

“My people come to you as people do, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear what you say, but they will not do it…”
They loved the sound of God’s voice through the prophet.
They just did not love obedience.

You can stream sermons.
Post verses.
Say “Amen.”
Know the language of revival.
And still be untouched in the places that matter most.

Because hearing is not the same as surrender.
Emotion is not repentance.
Conviction is not transformation unless it drives you to obey.

This is not just a warning against hypocrisy.
It is a mirror for every heart that enjoys holy things while resisting a holy God.

The real danger is not open rebellion.
It is religious agreement without inward change.
Jesus spoke of this too. The wise man does not merely hear His words. He does them. That is the house that stands.

So ask yourself honestly:
What has God already told me to leave?
What has He told me to forgive?
What has He told me to confess?
What has He told me to obey?
Do not clap for the truth while running from it.

Because the same Jesus who exposes dead religion also gives a new heart to the one who repents. He does not call you to change yourself first. He calls you to come broken, come honest, come now. His grace is not for spectators. It is for surrendering sinners.
Today, do not just hear Him.
